title: NexHub 1.1.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：新增本地内容导入体系——小说支持 TXT / EPUB，漫画支持 PDF / CBR / RAR / 7Z 等归档与整文件夹导入（Android 支持 SAF 文件夹）；设置搜索升级为 226 项全覆盖、直达具体设置项。无破坏性数据变更，旧数据与源 JSON 无需重新导入，可直接覆盖升级。
bodyEn: This update adds a full local content import pipeline: novels in TXT / EPUB, manga from PDF, CBR, RAR, 7Z archives or whole folders (Android SAF supported), plus a settings search that covers all 226 entries and jumps straight to the exact setting. No breaking data changes — your data and source JSON need no re-import; just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 1.0.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：首次启动 6 步新手引导、软件公告系统、Bangumi OAuth 登录重写修复（授权返回不再卡死转圈）。基础功能已完成，数据格式保持兼容，可放心升级。应用不内置任何站点，内容来自你导入的源。
bodyEn: This update: a 6-step onboarding guide, an in-app announcement system, and a rewritten Bangumi OAuth login (no more stuck spinner on return). Core features are complete and data stays compatible — safe to upgrade. The app ships no built-in sites; content comes from the sources you import.

title: NexHub 0.5.1 发布
body: 本次更新：软件公告与首次启动引导、Bangumi 登录改用内置浏览器、语言默认跟随系统。应用不内置任何站点，内容来自你导入的源。
bodyEn: This update: in-app announcements and first-launch onboarding, Bangumi sign-in now uses an embedded browser, and language defaults to following the system. The app ships no built-in sites; content comes from the sources you import.

title: 欢迎使用 NexHub
body: NexHub 是四合一媒体聚合客户端（动漫 / 漫画 / 小说 / 影视）。它不内置任何站点，解析能力全部来自可导入的「源」。导入社区维护的源后即可开始浏览。
bodyEn: NexHub is an all-in-one media client (anime / manga / novel / video). It ships no built-in sites; all parsing comes from importable 'sources'. Import a community-maintained source to start browsing.
